evidence: Documented in this repository, not a fresh runtime census. See online and corpus inventories for newly checked evidence.

families.lod: Keep ordinary prompt text. Attached context can have its own detail.
families.caveat: Parts, attachments and draft state are not necessarily submitted prompts.

families.types: modelState; isCanceled; hiddenFromTranscript; isSystemInitiated; systemInitiatedLabel; terminalExecutionId; origin
families.lod: State summary, not ordinary assistant prose.
families.caveat: A hidden/system-initiated request can still affect later conversation.

families.structure: Ordered response fragments, Markdown metadata, vulnerability warnings
families.lod: Keep complete by default, with citations and warnings.
families.caveat: Adjacent fragments do not establish missing whitespace. Vulnerability annotations are recorded claims, not exporter-validated findings.

families.types: thinking; reasoningText; reasoningBlocks; opaque continuation token
families.structure: Text/parts and optional duration; SDK fields differ
families.lod: Readable on/off; opaque count only.
families.caveat: Keep source labels. A model-written summary is not a full reasoning transcript.

families.structure: toolCallId, toolId, invocationMessage, pastTenseMessage, originMessage, isComplete, isConfirmed, source
families.lod: Identity/status line plus independently selected input/result.
families.caveat: Live API events and persisted records differ. Lifecycle copies are not extra calls.

families.structure: commandLine.original/forDisplay, terminalCommandOutput, terminalCommandState, cwd and other optional metadata
families.lod: Description/command/status; preview or complete output.
families.caveat: Displayed command can differ from actual command. Upstream truncation must remain labelled.

families.structure: Entries with id/title/status; not-started, in-progress, completed
families.lod: Latest list, status changes, or complete recorded updates.
families.caveat: Do not count snapshots as separate tasks.

families.structure: agentName, description, prompt, result; separate mapped child scope where present
families.lod: Delegation line/result/verified child transcript.
families.caveat: Summary fields do not contain the full child conversation.

families.lod: Selected fields, excerpt, complete supported record.
families.caveat: Arguments can contain full files and delegated prompts.

families.types: extensions; pullRequest; simpleToolInvocation; search; resources; modifiedFilesConfirmation; agentFeedbackReviewConfirmation; sessionCreated; generatedImage; automationConfigured
families.lod: Per-kind summary with JSON remainder where supported.
families.caveat: Declaration/previous review does not prove encounter in the new sample.

families.lod: Research only.
families.caveat: Repository documentation says it is omitted when serializing completed invocations.

families.types: URI/Location array; input/output details; serialized data
families.structure: input, inputLanguage, output[], isError, mcpOutput; type:data/mimeType/base64Data
families.lod: Inputs/results/errors/attachments independently selectable.
families.caveat: A single invocation can carry terminal, resultDetails and resource evidence together.

families.types: embed text; embed binary; refs; resource locations; MCP metadata
families.lod: Readable body, metadata or companion.
families.caveat: Do not expose raw Base64 to achieve complete text output.

families.structure: Response nodes and request scalar arrays
families.lod: Keep source identity/ranges separate from attached text.
families.caveat: A reference is not proof of available historical file bytes.

families.lod: Paths/status; summary; complete recorded edits.
families.caveat: Do not reconstruct a historical patch from current files. Not every listed type was historically observed.

families.lod: Boundary/action summaries.
families.caveat: A UI control marker is not a file edit by itself.

families.lod: Keep question and available user decision intelligible.
families.caveat: These are not interchangeable schemas. Historical deliberate ignores are not proof of absent source content.

families.lod: Off/milestones/complete recorded updates.
families.caveat: Live-only variants need not persist.

families.lod: Summary with actual status/error visible.
families.caveat: Dropping command buttons should not drop their explanatory text.

families.structure: Tree, extension suggestions, PR metadata and plan review
families.lod: Semantic text/table if supported, otherwise labelled fallback.
families.caveat: Source declaration is not existing renderer support.

families.lod: Keep current exclusions. Inventory for future policy only.
families.caveat: Claude provider chats remain out of scope. A compatibility enum does not broaden provider scope.

families.structure: Per-request model resolution in newer and older forms
families.lod: Short model label or detailed routing metadata.
families.caveat: Selected and answering models differ. Do not equate Fusion with Auto.

families.types: promptTokens; completionTokens; promptTokenDetails; modelTotals; copilotCredits; sessionCopilotCredits; elapsedMs; timeSpentWaiting
families.structure: Request metrics and potentially cumulative values
families.lod: Session summary, per-turn detail or omitted metrics.
families.caveat: Units and update semantics differ. No mixed-unit or cumulative double counting.

families.lod: Marker/summary/full recorded compaction.
families.caveat: Compaction is not saved memory, nor a substitute for missing original turns.

families.types: Direct Base64; $base64 object; byte array; numeric-keyed byte object; SDK session.binary_asset and assetId descriptors
families.structure: Submitted attachments, tool output image content and saved assets
families.lod: Reference/companion, independently from inline display.
families.caveat: Draft images are not extra submitted positions. Images bypass text redaction.
